request.text: Add a 'Last synced' timestamp column to the sync status table showing when each record was last synced from the source system.

open_questions.default: Assume it is a table managed via PostgresVectorDBClient and updated at the end of RevisionPipeline.run_complete_workflow, with no dedicated UI change in scope.
open_questions.q: Which table/schema is the 'sync status table' referenced in the request, and where is it rendered (admin UI, CLI report, API endpoint)? None of these are visible in the Context Pack.

tasks.description: Add a method to PostgresVectorDBClient (tools/vectordb/postgres_vector_db.py), e.g. update_last_synced(record_id, synced_at), that issues an UPDATE against the sync status table's 'last_synced_at' column using the existing _cursor() context manager and _db_error() logging pattern already used elsewhere in the class.
tasks.done_criteria: Calling the new method with a record id updates the last_synced_at column for that row in the database and errors are logged via the existing _db_error helper on failure
tasks.title: Add last_synced_at write path in PostgresVectorDBClient

tasks.description: In domain/revision/revision_pipeline.py, in run_complete_workflow, after the workflow completes successfully for a DocumentRevision, call the new PostgresVectorDBClient.update_last_synced with the current UTC timestamp for the synced record, using the existing _get_vector_handler() accessor.
tasks.done_criteria: run_complete_workflow triggers a last_synced_at update through the vector handler on successful completion, verified against a test double/mock of PostgresVectorDBClient
tasks.title: Call last_synced_at update at end of revision workflow

tasks.description: Add tests/tools/vectordb/test_postgres_vector_db.py covering PostgresVectorDBClient.update_last_synced: assert it issues the expected UPDATE against a test/mock DB connection and cursor, that a first call persists a last_synced_at value, and that a second call with a later timestamp overwrites the prior value.
tasks.done_criteria: New tests fail without update_last_synced and pass with it, covering both initial persistence and overwrite-on-resync behaviour
tasks.title: Test update_last_synced persists and overwrites the timestamp

tasks.description: Add tests/domain/revision/test_revision_pipeline.py asserting that RevisionPipeline.run_complete_workflow calls update_last_synced on the vector handler returned by _get_vector_handler() exactly once per successful run, using a mocked PostgresVectorDBClient, and that re-running the workflow for the same record triggers a second update call with a newer timestamp.
tasks.done_criteria: New tests fail before the run_complete_workflow change and pass after it, covering both the initial sync call and the resync/overwrite call
tasks.title: Test run_complete_workflow triggers last_synced_at update

assumptions.text: There exists a 'sync status table' in the Postgres database (accessed through PostgresVectorDBClient) that this request refers to, but its schema/migration file and the UI/report that renders it are not present in the Context Pack, so the exact column name, table name, and rendering location are unknown
RevisionPipeline.run_complete_workflow (domain/revision/revision_pipeline.py) is the point where a record is considered 'synced from the source system', so it is the place to write the new timestamp
The new column will be named 'last_synced_at' and set to the current UTC time at the moment the sync/revision completes

New test files tests/tools/vectordb/test_postgres_vector_db.py and tests/domain/revision/test_revision_pipeline.py do not yet exist in the pack but are needed to exercise the new update_last_synced method and its invocation from run_complete_workflow; they are placed under a tests/ directory mirroring the source tree, following common repo convention

criteria.given: a record is synced from the source system via the revision workflow
criteria.then: a 'last_synced_at' timestamp column value is persisted for that record in the database
criteria.when: the sync/revision pipeline completes writing the record

criteria.given: a record with an existing 'last_synced_at' value
criteria.then: the stored 'last_synced_at' value is updated to the new sync time and the previous value is overwritten
criteria.when: the record is synced again from the source system

spec.problem_statement: There is no visible 'last synced' timestamp surfaced for records in whatever view/table shows sync status; the Context Pack does not expose the sync status table's schema, route, or component, only tier-2 signatures for PostgresVectorDBClient (tools/vectordb/postgres_vector_db.py) and RevisionPipeline (domain/revision/revision_pipeline.py), which are the only files plausibly touching persisted sync/revision state. Done looks like: a persisted 'last synced' timestamp is written whenever a record is synced from the source system, and it is retrievable by whatever reads sync status, using PostgresVectorDBClient as the DB access point.
